remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)
add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__
    -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600
    -DWINVER=0x600
    -DUSE_NEW_WINE_REGISTER_RESOURCES)

spec2def(devenum.dll devenum.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(devenum registry devenum_classes.idl)

# devenum.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/devenum-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(devenum_shims OBJECT createdevenum.c devenum_main.c mediacatenum.c parsedisplayname.c)
target_link_libraries(devenum_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_canunload dmoguids strmiids uuid oldnames libole32 liboleaut32 libavicap32 libwinmm libuser32 libadvapi32 libadvapi32_vista libdsound libmsdmo libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(devenum_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_wine_module(devenum_shims)
add_dependencies(devenum_shims wineheaders)
set(DEVENUM_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/devenum/devenum_classes_r.o)
add_cargo_module(devenum devenum-cargo devenum.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS devenum_shims psdk devenum_r ${DEVENUM_REUSED} uuid_sources)
